# Grant

`schemas/records/grant.json`

A scoped, dated, expiring delegation of actions from an operator to a supervisor actor (docs/design/m0/04 "Grants"). A supervisor cannot create, extend or widen grants; confirmation overrides may only tighten. internal/authority enforces both.

|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | yes | [GrantID](common-defs.md#grantid) |  |

| `expires_at` | yes | [Time](common-defs.md#time) | Required: every grant expires. |

| `issued_by` | yes | [ActorID](common-defs.md#actorid) | An operator. |
| `approval` | yes | null or [ApprovalID](common-defs.md#approvalid) | The approval that confirmed the grant's proposal, recorded in the same command, whose actor is issued_by; null when an operator issued the grant directly (D31: policy none, whose approvals this build does not persist). |

No other fields are allowed.

## Definitions

### ActionKind

A mutating action kind of the action registry (schemas/vocab), e.g. task.create or policy.widen_destinations.

Type: string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*(\.[a-z][a-z0-9_]*)+$`)

### ProjectScope

The projects a grant covers: a list, or every project.

Type: `*` or array of [ProjectID](common-defs.md#projectid) (unique items)
